title: Oh My Aunt Came Back
transcription:
Oh My Aunt Came Back
A 'repeat after me' song with actions

Oh my aunt came back, (audience repeats)
From old Japan, (repeat)
And she brought with her (repeat)
A big hand fan. (repeat and commence
action of hand fan)

Repeat with other verses and actions such as:
Timbuktu: Gum to chew
The County Fair: A Rocking
Old Nepal: A Ping-Pong Ball
Mount Moran: A Ceiling Fan
Last Verse: Kalamazoo: SOME NUTS
LIKE YOU!
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription; small italic directions and playful spellings are uncertain.
